{{Top|leg}}
An '''adventure room''' was one of four rooms aboard the luxury [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Coral Vanda]]'' that used [[holographic generator]]s, [[tactile array]]s, and [[olfactory emitter]]s to create hyper-realistic simulations of exotic [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] locales.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
